svg.title: The software factory, from idea to merged code
svg.desc: Start from an idea, a Jira ticket, a GitHub issue or a spec file. Five stages: shape with /factory:vision, plan with the planner, build with /factory:run, merge, and ship documentation with /factory:docs. You answer, approve and merge; the next run sees each merge and starts the next wave.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You make the decisions. Claude agents plan, build, check and document. Nothing merges without you.
